lines.wake: Survivor, this is Southern Cross. If you can hear me, listen. Those people in the plaza aren't people anymore. Grab the crowbar by the bench. Over.
lines.crate: Copy. There's an army crate on the east side of the pyramid. Pry it open with the crowbar. Over.
lines.filters: Be advised, your mask filters won't last. The dead in the square still have gas masks. Take their filters. Three of them. Over.
lines.cruiser: There's a police cruiser in the southeast corner, lights still flashing. Pop the trunk. Body armor should be inside. Over.
lines.hospital: Side door under the west arcade leads to the church. The army turned it into a field hospital. Find the blood bags by the beds. Over.
lines.pyramid: Your gunfire is drawing them in. Get to the May Pyramid and hold through three waves. There's a shotgun at the base. Over.
lines.pyramid-go: Contact! Here they come. Hold the pyramid!
lines.wave2: Wave two. More of them this time.
lines.wave3: Final wave. Runners in the mix. Hold on!
lines.robots: An army squad went dark at the north crossing. There's a carbine in the snow. Watch yourself. Whatever tore them apart, it wasn't the dead. Over.
lines.robots-go: Something's moving out there. Those footsteps are metal.
lines.metro: Subway entrance, east side of the plaza. There's a train stuck at the platform, supply crates aboard. Bring up the ammo and the meds. Over.
lines.store: Corner store at the north crossing, next to that abandoned hatchback. Door's unlocked. There may still be food and meds on the shelves. Something's moving behind the counter. Over.
lines.radio: Last one. There's a military radio in front of the Pink House. Take the rifle, switch it on, and hold until the signal locks. Over.
lines.radio-on: Signal acquired. Keep that channel open, and don't let them near the radio. Over.
lines.radio-lost: Signal's dropping. Get back to the radio!

win.text: Plaza, this is the resistance at Puerto Montt. We hear you. Hold on. We'll be there before dawn. Out.
